title: All for masses for herself and her soul
html_source: That is to say she didn’t leave the Blooms any money but left it for masses (plural of the Christian ritual) to be said for the repose of her own soul–a nice income stream for the church!

anchor.prefix: o be laid up with a sick voice doing his highness to make himself interesting to that old faggot Mrs Riordan that he thought he had a great leg of and she never left us a farthing
